attendances.description: Employee attendance records with detailed clock in/out information, overtime, and attendance status

columns.employee_id: Foreign key to employees table - bigint(20) UNSIGNED
columns.clock_in_ip: IP address when clocking in - varchar(45), nullable
columns.clock_out_ip: IP address when clocking out - varchar(45), nullable
columns.off_desk_hours: Off desk hours flag - tinyint(1), default 0

employees.description: Employee personal and work information including contact details, employment status, and organizational relationships

columns.appraisal_date_mail: Appraisal date mail flag - int(1), default 0
columns.office_shift_id: Foreign key to office_shifts table - bigint(20) UNSIGNED, nullable
columns.company_id: Foreign key to companies table - bigint(20) UNSIGNED, nullable
columns.department_id: Foreign key to departments table - bigint(20) UNSIGNED, nullable
columns.designation_id: Foreign key to designations table - bigint(20) UNSIGNED, nullable
columns.location_id: Foreign key to locations table - bigint(20) UNSIGNED, nullable
columns.role_users_id: Foreign key to role_users table - bigint(20) UNSIGNED, nullable
columns.status_id: Foreign key to statuses table - bigint(20) UNSIGNED, nullable
columns.probation_period: Probation period end date - date, nullable

office_shifts.description: Shift schedules for different companies with specific in/out times for each day of the week

columns.company_id: Foreign key to companies table - bigint(20) UNSIGNED
columns.sunday_in: Sunday clock in time - varchar(191), nullable
columns.sunday_out: Sunday clock out time - varchar(191), nullable
columns.saturday_in: Saturday clock in time - varchar(191), nullable
columns.saturday_out: Saturday clock out time - varchar(191), nullable
columns.friday_in: Friday clock in time - varchar(191), nullable
columns.friday_out: Friday clock out time - varchar(191), nullable
columns.thursday_in: Thursday clock in time - varchar(191), nullable
columns.thursday_out: Thursday clock out time - varchar(191), nullable
columns.wednesday_in: Wednesday clock in time - varchar(191), nullable
columns.wednesday_out: Wednesday clock out time - varchar(191), nullable
columns.tuesday_in: Tuesday clock in time - varchar(191), nullable
columns.tuesday_out: Tuesday clock out time - varchar(191), nullable
columns.monday_in: Monday clock in time - varchar(191), nullable
columns.monday_out: Monday clock out time - varchar(191), nullable
